dialogue.content: お願い致します。
dialogue.English: Shall we begin?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 時間が早いですが13時まで待っていますか
dialogue.English: We're a little early. Would you like to wait until 1:00 PM?

dialogue.content: 始めてしまって大丈夫です！
dialogue.English: It's fine to start now!

dialogue.content: ではよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Alright then, let's get started.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い申し上げます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 女性　２０代　ゆなです相談内容は、相手の気持ちが分からず、知らないうちに仲間外れにされて困っています。
dialogue.English: I'm Yuna, a woman in my 20s. My concern is that I don't understand others' feelings, and I've been left out without realizing it, which is troubling me.

dialogue.content: どうしたら人の気持ちが分かるようになりますか？
dialogue.English: How can I become better at understanding people's feelings?

dialogue.content: 仲間はずれは女性どうしからですか
dialogue.English: Is this exclusion from other women?

dialogue.content: そうです。いつも仲良くしてる友達が3人いて、私を入れて4人でいつも遊んでいるのですが、そのうちの1人と2人で遊んだ時に、悩みを相談されて、答えたんですけど、それがなにかおかしかったのか、その日以降、他の2人と私を抜いて頻繁に遊んでいるみたいで。
dialogue.English: Yes. I have three close friends, and the four of us usually hang out together. I spent time one-on-one with one of them, and she shared a concern and I responded, but maybe there was something off about what I said. Since that day, it seems she and the other two have been hanging out frequently without me.

dialogue.content: グループLINEにメッセージをいれても、既読無視されるのです。
dialogue.English: Even when I post in our group LINE chat, they leave me on read.

dialogue.content: 辛くはないのですが、腹立たしいです。
dialogue.English: I’m not exactly hurt, but I feel angry and frustrated.

dialogue.content: それははらただしいですね
dialogue.English: That must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい！言いたい事があるなら言えってグループLINEでも言ってるのに、無視されます。
dialogue.English: Yes! I even said in the group LINE chat, "If you have something to say, just say it," but they ignore me.

dialogue.content: 今まで仲良くしていたのに
dialogue.English: Especially after you all got along so well before.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ！
dialogue.English: Exactly!

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think I should do?

dialogue.content: 私が悪いんですかね？
dialogue.English: Is it my fault?

dialogue.content: 考えただけで、はらただしいですね
dialogue.English: Just thinking about it is infuriating, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。謝りようがないんですよ。
dialogue.English: That’s right. I don’t even know how I could apologize.

dialogue.content: 貴方は悪くありません
dialogue.English: You are not to blame.

dialogue.content: ですよね！？
dialogue.English: Right!?

dialogue.content: わかってもらえて嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I'm so glad you understand.

dialogue.content: なにが悪かったか。もし悪い事があるなら、謝るけど、今の状態では、私の言い分も話せないので、謝れないです。
dialogue.English: I don't know what I did wrong. If I did something wrong, I'd apologize, but in this situation, I can't even explain my side of things, so I can't apologize.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。会社かんけいですか
dialogue.English: I see. Are these work-related friends?

dialogue.content: 高校の同級生です。社会人になってからも遊んでいたのですが、その事があってから避けられてるようで。
dialogue.English: They're high school classmates. We kept hanging out even after we started working, but since that incident, it feels like they’ve been avoiding me.

dialogue.content: 同級生なんですね
dialogue.English: So you were classmates.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。一年生のときみんな同じクラスで、お弁当を毎日一緒に食べる仲でした。
dialogue.English: Yes. In our first year, we were all in the same class and were close enough to eat lunch together every day.

dialogue.content: 楽しかった時の仲間では余計にはらただしくなりますよね
dialogue.English: It must be even more infuriating when it's friends you've had such good times with.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。隠し事はやめようっていってたのに…
dialogue.English: Exactly. And we even promised not to keep secrets from each other...

dialogue.content: 今はあまりとらわれないで、その時間貴方の趣味で行動してみては
dialogue.English: For now, why don't you try not to dwell on it and spend that time on your hobbies instead?

dialogue.content: 長所を伸ばすと嫌なことは少しずつうすらいでいきます
dialogue.English: If you focus on developing your strengths, the unpleasant feelings will gradually fade.

dialogue.content: なるほど！時がたてば解決るのかな…
dialogue.English: I see! Maybe it will resolve itself over time...

dialogue.content: そうですよ。貴方の得意は何ですか
dialogue.English: That's right. What are you good at?

dialogue.content: えっと…得意なことはないですが、漫画とか本とか読むのが好きですね！
dialogue.English: Um... I'm not particularly good at anything, but I do like reading things like manga and books!

dialogue.content: 明るくふるまっているあなたを見て友達はびっくりしますよ
dialogue.English: Your friends will be surprised to see you acting so cheerful.

dialogue.content: 沢山本を読んで
dialogue.English: Read lots of books.

dialogue.content: なるほど！
dialogue.English: I see!

dialogue.content: 嫌なことを追い出しましょう
dialogue.English: Let's drive out those unpleasant feelings.

dialogue.content: どうですか
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうですね…！
dialogue.English: You're right...!

dialogue.content: あまり考えないように過ごしてみたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I think I’ll try to spend my time without thinking about it too much.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。友達もとらわれない貴方をそんけいしますよね
dialogue.English: Right. Your friends will probably respect you for not being hung up on it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 何も無かったようにまた仲良くなれますよ
dialogue.English: You'll be able to be good friends again, as if nothing ever happened.

dialogue.content: でも、やっぱりこのままなのも気持ちが悪い…
dialogue.English: But, I still feel uneasy leaving things as they are...

dialogue.content: どうしたら相手が私と連絡取れるようになってくれますね？
dialogue.English: How can I get them to start contacting me again?

dialogue.content: 話し合いもしたいんですが…
dialogue.English: I’d like to talk it out, too…

dialogue.content: 大事なともだちですものね
dialogue.English: They are important friends to you, after all.

dialogue.content: そうなんです…
dialogue.English: Yes, they are...

dialogue.content: なのでこれからも一緒に遊びにいきたいし、また前みたい仲良くしていきたいんです…
dialogue.English: That's why I want to keep hanging out with them and be close like we were before...

dialogue.content: 気持ちを早く楽になにたいですよね
dialogue.English: You want to feel at ease as soon as possible, don't you?

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ…何かいい解決方法とかありますかね…？
dialogue.English: Exactly… Is there any good way to resolve this?

dialogue.content: 友達は近くですか
dialogue.English: Do your friends live nearby?

dialogue.content: 住まいがですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean where they live?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でしたら近くですね
dialogue.English: In that case, yes, they're nearby.

dialogue.content: 近くなら、会いにいき元気に挨拶からしてみては
dialogue.English: If they're nearby, how about going to see them and starting with a cheerful greeting?

dialogue.content: うーん、面と向かって話すしか…話にいくしかないんでしょうかね…
dialogue.English: Hmm, so talking face-to-face... is that really the only way...?

dialogue.content: 直接会って心を確認出来るとあんしんできるんですがね
dialogue.English: You would feel more at ease if you could meet them in person and find out how they really feel.

dialogue.content: うーん、そう素直に応じてくれるでしょうか…？
dialogue.English: Hmm, I wonder if they'd really be willing to talk so easily...?

dialogue.content: 気持ちをききたいですよね
dialogue.English: You want to know how they feel, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい！聞きたいです、でも、突然行って頭てくれるか不安で…
dialogue.English: Yes! I do want to know, but I'm worried about whether they'll even see me if I show up unannounced...

dialogue.content: 今までのようにたのしいなかまでいたいこと伝えられるといいのですが
dialogue.English: It would be good if you could convey that you want to remain good friends and have fun like before.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: You're right...

dialogue.content: きっと時間がたてばあなたのこころが通じるとおもいます
dialogue.English: I’m sure that with time, your feelings will get through to them.

dialogue.content: ほんとうは友達もまたみんなで仲良くしたいと思っているかもしれませんよね
dialogue.English: The truth is, your friends might also be wishing you could all get along again.

dialogue.content: 信じて待つしかなさそうですね。
dialogue.English: It seems like all I can do is believe and wait.

dialogue.content: 相手に既読無視されてる以上、直接行っても居留守使われてしまいそうだし。
dialogue.English: Since they’re leaving me on read, even if I go in person they might pretend not to be home.

dialogue.content: きっと時が解決してくれるとおもいます。だって大切な友達ですもの。
dialogue.English: I believe time will surely resolve this. After all, they are your precious friends.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、少し何もせず待ちたいと思います…
dialogue.English: Thank you. I think I'll wait a little while without doing anything...

dialogue.content: 事が落ち着くまでもう少しの辛抱です
dialogue.English: You just have to be patient a little longer until things calm down.

dialogue.content: あなたら、きっと大丈夫です
dialogue.English: You'll be fine, I'm sure of it.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今度また来て結果をおしえてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please come again and let me know how it goes.

dialogue.content: 今日は来てくださってありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: これで今日は終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: This concludes our session for today.
